Perfect! White captures the bishop for a net +3 material gain (won a bishop). The main line is: **Nxf6+ Kh8 Nxd5**.

**Best move:** Nxf6+

**Main line:** Nxf6+ Kh8 Nxd5

**Motif:** fork

**Coaching note:**

When you give check, look immediately at what else your checking piece attacks. Here, Nxf6+ checks the king while simultaneously attacking the undefended bishop on d5. Black must move the king, then you simply capture the bishop, winning material cleanly. In any position, a check that attacks two things at once is a powerful fork—look for it!
